title: Custom colored text, pressed icons and focus borders can lose contrast
scope: User selected UX-003 and authorized completing confirmed fixes unattended. Preserve vivid global colors and interaction design; adjust only unreadable local ink and propagate the drawer surface accurately.

evidence.windows_before: Native Windows original controls: day name 1.198:1, armed pulley 1.211:1, focused combo 1.236:1, Dark Purple pressed editor icon 2.031:1 (out/ux003/before-focused.txt, pulley-before.txt). The final Layout-preserving tab regression separately fails against the original AboutDialog source at 1.203:1 under offscreen/software with Windows fonts (tab-before-final-fixture.txt), then passes after restoring the fix (tab-after-final-fixture.txt).
evidence.drawer_before: out/ux003/menu-before.txt: real Menu reports #fffbfe to descendants while painting #d1d1d1 in Light. Its corrected inherited background passes menu-after.txt.
evidence.android_before: Original UI-028 APK, real held pull and screenshot: original Yellow day-name and armed-pulley minima are about 1.004:1 and 1.000:1. See out/ux003/android-before-final/results.json. Native About driver initially tapped an offscreen button; those navigation failures are not contrast evidence.

implementation: Theme.readableInk adjusts only ink that lacks contrast, using the owning neutral surface and conservative photographic extreme for opacity 0.8. Weekdays names, selected license tab labels, armed pulley, both pressed editor icons and combo focus borders use it. Menu propagates its unchanged painted surface through Material.background. All palette families, vivid fills, button semantics, geometry, animations and gestures remain intact.

regression.test: tests/customcolors/tst_customcolors.qml: all 19 families Light/Dark, native System, both photographic extremes, actual glyph pixels, held editor presses, live persistent controls, real Menu propagation, both selected license tabs and painted focus border. Two normal CTest entries.
regression.before: Focused original Windows cases fail; actual old Menu propagation fails. Native pull captures independently fail.
regression.after: Final offscreen custom-color matrix: 268 passed. Native Windows D3D11 WARP: 282 passed. Both are normal CTest entries, with zero failures/skips; original-source negative controls fail as recorded. Full suite reports total 1,622 records across 17 entries.
regression.android: tests/android/test_customcolors.py: six representative explicit/System profiles with real touch and adjacent same-frame ink/surface sampling.
regression.driver_notes: Initial selected-tab probe hid its Layout child and moved a logo into the reference region; its 1.073:1 value is excluded. The final fixture keeps Layout allocation with opacity zero and hides only Control-owned TextIcon content without reflow. Earlier opacity-only TextIcon comparisons sampled its transition; final hiding avoids that animation. A stale OneDrive-restored source timestamp required regenerating Menu QML; an invalid Windows incremental-link artifact required a fresh link. These are retained validation/fixture issues, not additional app defects.
regression.android_after: All 48 checks pass across six explicit/System profiles in out/ux003/android-colors-final/results.json. Current-day labels, armed pulleys, pressed editor icons, slider fill/boundaries and both selected license tabs are measured on actual rendered frames. Data identities/order/flags remain exact. The normal keyboard/drawer/About path runs in a fresh app phase, independently of the synthetic held press; existing full About workflow also passes 26 checks.

verification.windows: Combined color/Undo tree: All 17 normal Windows CTest entries pass: 1622 records, zero failures/skips. General entries, the main UI rerun including the new drawer test, and corrected offscreen/native custom-color rechecks were run in filtered groups. See out/ux003/windows-results.json and logs.
verification.static_analysis: Both Samuel-profile clang-tidy and Clazy pass all 7 tracked C++ translation units (14 analyzer runs), out/ux003/analysis.
verification.qml_lint: QShopper_qmllint exits 0 with five existing warnings: RoundButton alias, Qt.inputMethod commit/show QObject, and generated keyboard item.active/implicitHeight QObject. No new warnings in changed color bindings.
verification.formatting: All 67 tracked QML/templates and all 11 tracked C++ files match accepted formatter configurations. git diff --check passes.
verification.android: Combined color/Undo tree: All 283 native Android checks pass on the final APK: 48 custom colors, 6 post-reset cleanup, 24 recovery/IME/expiry/resume, 26 full About, 42 popup contrast and 137 System drawer/safe-area checks. Source scripts use isolated data; commands completed with clean final teardown. Reports are retained in out/ux003 and out/ux005.
verification.environment_notes: Initial native popup assertions all 42 passed but teardown timed out after emulator host-GPU external-memory/context errors. A fresh emulator rerun passes 42 with exit 0. System/safe-area harness rejected an old shared /sdcard XML file (Bad address); the final driver uses a unique shell-temporary dump and its 137 checks pass. These host/driver failures are retained as validation history, not additional application defects.

apk.package_contract: Both ABIs pass dependency closure, unwanted-payload and production QML scan-root checks; both signatures verify.
apk.build_note: Native C++/QML targets built normally. Gradle rejected OneDrive resource reparse metadata, so final APKs were assembled from byte-identical generated inputs in task-specific temporary staging outside OneDrive, then signed/contract-checked. Logs and helper are retained in out/ux003; repository build scripts are unchanged.
apk.phone_acceptance: 2026-11-07: user tested and accepted the supplied APK, then requested ticket closure and commits. No physical-device installation by agent.

resolution.acceptance: 2026-11-07: user tested the supplied APK and requested: Tested, Close and Commit.
resolution.summary: Use readable local ink on its actual surface while preserving vivid global colors and all interaction behavior.
resolution.verification: Combined color/Undo tree: all 17 Windows suites pass (1,622 records), all 283 native Android checks pass, both APK package/signature checks pass, and formatter/static-analysis results are recorded above.
resolution.regression: Permanent test locations, original-source failures, passing-after results and fixture/environment dispositions are recorded in this ticket and its linked review.
resolution.remaining: None within the accepted scope. Broader physical-shopping, dictation and accessibility studies remain their separate QA scope.
